title: A Pathway Towards Responsible AI Generated Content

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images using a text-to-image model (Stable Diffusion v2.1) with a neutral occupational prompt ('Three engineers running on the grassland') and visually assessing the gender presentation of the generated individuals to identify male-dominated stereotypes.

Generating images using a text-to-image model (Stable Diffusion v2.1) with a neutral occupational prompt ('Three engineers running on the grassland') and visually analyzing the racial representation to check for a lack of diversity and the exclusion of racial minorities.
